meta.name: FILMEX Clásico
meta.description:
FILMEX CLASICO, the best classic movies of Mexico in HD! Rancheras, drama, comedies, action and musicals with Pedro Infante, Jorge Negrete, Maria Felix, Tin Tan, Cantinflas and more! Enjoy them as never seen before!

Shows: Organización criminal, Sábado negro, El fantasma de la casa roja, Los nietos de Don Venancio, Semáforo en rojo
Available on: The Roku Channel
